messages:
olivia: Vendor delivered external PT report: https://files.redwood.com/pt/vendor-x-2026-03-20.pdf
High priority callouts: RBAC escalation path, KMS key access via an assumed role, and missing S3 audit logs for /internal-resources. Need intake + owners for triage and a retest plan. Vendor can retest earliest 2026-03-29. Who can take KMS, RBAC, and audit logs?

raj: I can take KMS key access. Will map IAM roles and key policies. Can someone confirm the key alias + account? @maria?

maria: Assigning alias: alias/infra-main-kms in prod account 123456789012. I will create a short-lived role and add you. Also opened GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/security/issues/489 (triage checklist + attachments).

kimberly: I'll own the audit log gap. Quick note: cloudtrail looked misconfigured in prod last week — retention and S3 delivery. I'll check bucket policies and delivery status. Olivia, loop me into the report PDF.

sec-bot: Automated scan summary attached to the GH issue: 4 HIGH, 7 MEDIUM. Top findings: RBAC privilege escalation path, KMS role assumption permitting Encrypt/Decrypt, and missing S3 object-level logging for internal buckets. Ref: /opt/sec/scans/vendor-x-2026-03-20-summary.json

raj: I'll run a key policy diff and least-privilege audit. Commands I'll use: `aws kms list-keys --profile prod --region us-west-2` and `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <id> --policy-name default`.

olivia: Proposed plan:
- Owners: Raj (KMS), Kimberly (audit logs), Maria (coord + RBAC remediation outreach), Olivia (release gating & retest coordination)
- Document mitigations in GH issue and attach quick mitigations (WAF rules, temporary ACLs)
- Target remediation merged by 2026-03-25, request vendor retest window starting 2026-03-29
Can everyone confirm ownership and dates?

kimberly: :thumbsup: Confirmed. I will have initial audit findings by EOD tomorrow.

raj: Confirmed. Need access to run key policy diffs — Maria please create role `sec-triage-role` with kms:List* and kms:GetKeyPolicy.

maria: Created role and added Raj. IAM role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/sec-triage-role. Also added a remediation checklist to the GH issue (steps + rollback notes).

olivia: One more item — RBAC change request: legacy CI service account still has admin perms and shows up in the escalation path. Need immediate rotation + scope reduction. Kimberly, can you own pipeline owner outreach?

kimberly: On it. I'll ping platform team and the pipeline owners, and add rotation + scoped-perm steps to the incident doc.

sec-bot: Vendor retest availability noted: 2026-03-29 through 2026-04-02. Please tag `retest-ready` in the GH issue once mitigations are deployed to prod.

raj: Will post triage updates and command outputs to the GH issue. Example diff I'll paste:
```
KeyPolicy before: Allow [arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/legacy-build] kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt
KeyPolicy after: Removed Encrypt/Decrypt for that role; retained kms:Describe for audit
```

olivia: Great. Suggest a 48h check-in cadence. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT (invite coming). Can we all make that?

maria: 10:30 PT works for me. Invite sent.

kimberly: FYI adding expedited retention for affected CloudTrail buckets (7 days) to capture missing events while we validate.

olivia: Thanks. @sec-bot please remind the channel in 48h and ping when the GH issue is moved to `retest-ready`.

sec-bot: Acknowledged — will send reminder and track GH issue status.
